resources.string: When connecting to a Bluetooth device whose name contains “%1$s”
Starts by itself when plugged in
Size of the Qonecta+ interface (panel and its own screens) on the car screen, Auto extended only. Automatic: as is on the C10 and smaller on small screens like the T03\'s. Applies on reconnect.
The panel colour, transparency and buttons are chosen in Settings on the car screen.
More heat and battery. Otherwise it turns off as usual and projection continues.
While projecting. Not needed; leaving it makes the phone reload every app (like a soft reset). Applies to the next session.
For testing. A value here overrides the profile; empty = automatic (the profile\'s or what the car asks for).
Set by the profile; use more battery
Frames in flight with the throttle
Enter a number from 0 to %1$d (empty = automatic)
One log line per frame, touches, performance and the full logcat: more heat and very large logs. Applies when you reconnect.
